item.title: Best part of CodepaLOUsa so far
item.description: Best part of CodepaLOUsa so far… Sitting next to Douglas Crockford at dinner tonight. Occasionally I’m the lucky one. (Hope I didn’t bore him too much) Anyway – having a fun time at CodepaLOUsa and hope all other attendees are too.
